camel_example: aliyun cloudauth-intl CredentialRecognitionIntlV2 --region cn-hangzhou --ProductCode CREDENTIAL_RECOGNITION --OcrArea 0101 --FraudCheck false --DocType 01 --version 2022-08-09 --method POST --force
description_en: An API operation that uploads a credential image, such as a utility bill or credit card statement, and uses Qwen-VL to intelligently fetch the billing address and name
description_zh: API接口，上传凭证图片，包括：水电煤、信用卡账单等，通过通义VL智能提取账单地址及姓名
name: CredentialRecognitionIntlV2

parameters.help_en: The product solution to use. Set the value to CREDENTIAL_RECOGNITION
parameters.help_zh: 要接入的产品方案。取值 CREDENTIAL_RECOGNITION
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The Base64-encoded image. If you choose to pass in the image by using IdOcrPictureBase64 (Base64-encoded photo), check the photo size and do not pass in an excessively large photo
parameters.help_zh: 图片Base64编码。如果您选择IdOcrPictureBase64（照片Base64编码）方式传入照片，请注意检查照片大小，不要传入过大的照片
parameters.name: credential_ocr_picture_base64

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image. The URL must be a publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS link
parameters.help_zh: 图片地址，公网可访问的HTTP、HTTPS链接
parameters.name: credential_ocr_picture_url

parameters.help_en:
The credential type. Valid values:

01: transaction credential (including electronic bill images for water, electricity, gas, credit cards, and other types)
02: vehicle registration certificate
03: transfer transaction record
04: POA address proof
parameters.help_zh:
凭证类型：

01：交易凭据（包括：水、电、煤、信用卡等各类电子账单图片）
02：车辆登记证明
03：转账交易流水
04：poa地址证明
parameters.name: doc_type

parameters.help_en:
The extraction type. Valid values:

0101: electronic bill address and name module (extracts address and name modules through intelligent analysis)
0201: Thailand vehicle registration certificate
0301: transfer transaction amount information
0401: POA credential extraction information
parameters.help_zh:
提取类型：

0101：电子账单地址和姓名模块（通过智能分析提取地址及姓名模块）
0201:  泰国车辆登记证明
0301：转账交易流水金额信息
0401：poa凭证提取信息
parameters.name: ocr_area

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable tampering detection. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启篡改检测
true：开启
false：关闭
parameters.name: fraud_check

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable quality detection. Valid values: Y (enabled) and N (disabled)
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启质量检测 Y: 开启, N: 关闭
parameters.name: id_quality

parameters.help_en: The field validation rule configuration, in JSON string format
parameters.help_zh: 字段校验规则配置，JSON字符串
parameters.name: check_rule_config

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable OCR result normalization. Valid values: 0 (disabled) and 1 (enabled)
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启OCR结果标准化 0: 关闭, 1: 开启
parameters.name: ocr_value_standard

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable translation. Valid values: 0 (disabled) and 1 (enabled)
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启翻译 0: 关闭, 1: 开启
parameters.name: ocr_translation

parameters.help_en:
The input material type. Valid values:

IMAGE (default): image
PDF: PDF format
parameters.help_zh:
素材输入类型：

IMAGE（默认）：图片
PDF：pdf 格式
parameters.name: file_input_type

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates a successful request. Other values indicate failures
Code.description_zh: 返回码：返回200表示请求成功，其他均为失败

ExtIdInfo.description_en: The recognized key information, in JSON format
ExtIdInfo.description_zh: 识别的关键信息，JSON 格式

SubCode.description_en:
The result code. Valid values:

200: OCR extraction succeeded and all rule checks passed.
204: Validation result is inconsistent. OCR extraction succeeded, but some fields in CheckRuleConfig did not pass (N).
211: Quality does not meet requirements. Quality detection did not pass when idQuality is set to Y (not yet supported in the current version).
212: Anti-forgery check did not pass. fraudCheck was triggered and anti-forgery verification failed.
213: No text was extracted, or the credential type check did not pass
SubCode.description_zh:
结果码

200：OCR 提取成功，且规则检查全部通过
204：校验结果不一致，OCR 提取成功，但 CheckRuleConfig 中存在字段不通过（N）
211：质量不符合，idQuality=Y 时质量检测不通过（当前版本暂未接入）
212：防伪检查不通过，fraudCheck 触发且防伪验证失败
213：未提取到文字 / 证件类型检查不通过

Success.description_en:
The extraction result. Valid values:
S: Succeeded.
F: Failed
Success.description_zh:
提取结果。取值：
S：成功。
F：失败
